newsitem.title: USA: ML Bancorp to acquire Penncore Financial.
newsitem.headline: ML Bancorp to acquire Penncore Financial.

text.p: ML Bancorp Inc, parent company of Main Line Bank, said Tuesday it had reached a definitive agreement to acquire Penncore Financial Services Corp for $14.1 million.
ML said it would offer Penncore shareholders to either exchange each share they own for $36.56 in cash or 2.5 common shares of ML Bancorp.
No more than 49 percent of Penncore shares would be converted into cash, and no more than 70 percent of Penncore shares would be converted into ML Bancorp common stock, it said.
In conjunction with the acquisition, ML Bancorp will seek approval from its primary regulatory agency to repurchase up to five percent of its common stock in the open market.
ML said it expected to close the deal during the third quarter of 1997.
It said the acquisition would likely be neutral for its earnings per share in its fiscal year ending March 31, 1998 and be accretive in fiscal 1999 and beyond.

Based in Newtown, Pa., Penncore has $138 million in assets and is the holding company of Commonwealth State Bank, while ML Bancorp has $1.9 billion in assets and operates 24 branches throughout the Greater Philadelphia region.
After the merger, Commonwealth State Bank would operate as a division of Main Line Bank, ML said.
